title: MaterialsScience NanoparticleSynthSOP

stats.done_summary: Created an executable pilot-scale nanoparticle SOP (nanoparticle_sop.md) from raw notes using code/build_sop.py, including system inference, traceability excerpt, parameter trace lines, CPP/CQA guidance, and system-specific default recipe + operating sequence. Generated intermediate audit logs (outputs/mentions.csv, outputs/actions.csv, outputs/metadata.csv). Produced required figures as PNGs in report/images (unit/action frequencies, mention positions, mention density, conversion flow) via code/make_figures.py. Wrote comprehensive report/report.md with methodology, results, discussion, and embedded figures; added scripts to update report stats/tokens and a one-command reproducibility runner (code/run_all.py).
